request: Build F03-T04: web infrastructure (models, ApiService.listBookmarks, relative-time, url-display, icons).

response: Implemented as planned; the first test run failed one test on an async-timing gap in a flush-without-await test (fixed with await Promise.resolve()); then self-caught that loadList()'s failure path reused toApiError(error).message instead of F03-AC11's one fixed message, and fixed it before starting T06.

request: Build F03-T06: the list and card markup (count region, loading/empty/error states, card row).

request: Build F03-T07: the pagination control (page-size select, Previous/Next, Page X of Y text).
response: Implemented the markup to match LD-03's chosen shape first, confirmed it compiled, then added 4 tests proving F03-AC4/AC6/AC9/AC10; two clean build-verify passes, 82/82 tests passing.

request: Build F03-T08: wire <app-bookmark-list> into the app shell, call loadList() on startup, wire addRequested to openDialog(), run the F03-AC7 restart spot check and the F03-AC9 keyboard walkthrough.

request: Gate Summary for the F03 build and APPROVE.
response: dev-1 approved the Build gate. Recorded the gate in status.md and backlog.md (F03 -> built), rolled up tasks.md + the 4 E-build-30x records into docs/03-build.md (Implementation Plan vs Actual, Feature Evidence Matrix, Troubleshooting, Significant Human Changes, AI Interactions, Local Run Evidence), and offered handoff to /test-phase F03-list-bookmarks.
